name: agent-liveness-bounded-parallel-runner
title: Run the nested agent-liveness smoke suite with bounded parallelism
description: The root DONE-required full suite deterministically fails after a cold build because flow-stability-smoke serially launches seven agent-liveness child smokes, exceeding the 120-second member timeout and the 300-second full-suite budget. Preserve both gates and reduce the critical path by executing independent child smokes with bounded concurrency.
